title: A look at Iranian cyber unit Shahid Kaveh, which France said recently hacked supermarket freezers; in 2023 and 2024, it hacked Israeli-made industrial devices (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: A look at Iranian cyber unit Shahid Kaveh, which France said recently hacked supermarket freezers; in 2023 and 2024, it hacked Israeli-made industrial devices — One night in October, hackers staged one of the most unusual cyber attacks in history: cranking up the temperature in refrigeration systems …
